title: Neuro-Olfactive Intelligence (NOI): Reproducible Research Framework
description: Version 0.1.0 of a proprietary, publicly inspectable research framework for reproducible simulation and evaluation of neuro-olfactive artificial intelligence, contextual olfactory memory, multimodal odor representation, corrective associative memory, graded out-of-distribution behavior, and deterministic policy conformance. The evidence is exploratory and limited to controlled simulations. It does not establish clinical validity, real-world odor sensing, deployment readiness, or comprehensive safety.
